_note: Batch I: 6497 BMI calculator (1,991 words, 6 cards) and 6220 sustainable weight loss (2,298 words, 8 cards). On 6497 the four risk sections are NOT carded: those are population-level risk associations the text hedges per person, and a graphic listing 'heart disease, diabetes, cancer' under a BMI band would read as a personal prognosis. The categories card carries the cut-offs only.

cards.subject: weight loss
cards.heading: What Healthy Weight Loss Actually Means
title: What Healthy
Weight Loss
Means
cards.alt: Healthy weight loss runs 0.5 to 2 pounds a week, counts non-scale wins, and treats BMI as a screening tool only

items.label: 0.5 to 2 lb a week
items.note: A pace most adults can hold

items.label: Beyond the scale
items.note: Waist, A1C, blood pressure, stamina, sleep

items.label: BMI screens only
items.note: It does not measure muscle or where fat sits

cards.subject: weight loss
cards.heading: Evidence-Based Nutrition Patterns That Work
title: Nutrition That Sustains
Weight Loss
cards.alt: Sustainable weight loss nutrition: 20 to 40g protein per meal, 25 to 38g fiber daily, healthy fats, and water first

items.label: Fiber
items.note: 25 to 38 grams a day for most people

items.label: Healthy fats
items.note: Olive oil, nuts, seeds, avocado, in portions

cards.subject: weight loss
cards.heading: Movement: Training for Fat Loss and Lifelong Health
title: Movement That Supports
Weight Loss
cards.alt: Weight loss movement: 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity weekly, strength on two days, and hourly movement breaks

items.label: Every hour
items.note: 3 to 5 minutes of stairs or a walk

cards.subject: weight loss
cards.heading: Sleep, Stress, and the Metabolism Connection
title: Sleep and Stress in
Weight Loss
cards.alt: Sleep 7 to 9 hours, take short stress breaks, and keep protein and fiber snacks ready for your known trigger times

items.label: Short breaks
items.note: Five minutes of breathing, a ten-minute walk

items.label: Snacks ready
items.note: Protein and fiber, for your trigger times

cards.subject: weight loss
cards.heading: Safety First: When to Seek Care
cards.alt: Stop and call a clinician during weight loss for dizziness or fainting, chest pain or palpitations, or rapid unexplained loss
cards.headline: Call your clinician

signs.text: Rapid weight loss you cannot explain

cards.footer: Also: persistent stomach problems or extreme fatigue
